title: Production Verbose Stack Trace / Debug Exposure
pattern: Emitting full database connection parameters, internal variable trace layouts, or unhandled compiler execution panics directly to production terminal outputs or client interfaces.
why_bad: Provides adversaries with sensitive operational context, such as database port addresses, internal directory names, variable schemas, and version dependencies, simplifying targeted exploit craft.
detection: Unhandled `panic!` or logging macros containing trace-level context running in production target builds.
fix: Disable verbose logging outputs or panics in production; map all production logic errors to standardized, abstract client messages while caching traces in secure server logs.
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 12, p. 252.
